summary: Require stable taskId+stepId at Slack admission for execution-grade Chat/Work RPCs and render correlated work task-centrically in claw-live.
reason: Remote Bridge already supported task-step idempotence, but recent Chat RPC receipts omitted correlation fields, so execution dedupe and task-level anti-loop controls were not consistently exercised.

tests.name: remote-bridge-slack
tests.evidence: uncorrelated execution rejected before effect; correlated active write, B64, duplicate idempotence, unauthorized user and health passed

capabilities.reason: Slack admission now enforces task-step correlation for execution-grade methods; no new executor or permission.

architecture.reason: Existing Slack adapter, Remote Bridge receipts and claw-live renderer are extended in place; no new daemon, scheduler, store or execution owner.

rollback: Restore the preceding immutable release or revert this source commit. Core Remote Bridge receipts remain compatible because taskId/stepId were already supported.
limitations: Task-level no_progress policy remains owned by skill_intelligence.task_checkpoint; this runtime guard prevents exact logical-step replay but does not invent retry policy.
Pure read methods remain usable without taskId+stepId unless the caller voluntarily correlates them.
Runtime activation and live Chat-to-S24 acceptance are recorded separately after publication.
